term: New Zealand Institute for Advanced Technology
definition: The New Zealand Institute for Advanced Technology (NZIAT) is a proposed scientific research agency that would be responsible for boosting economic development through investment in advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing.
details: The New Zealand Institute for Advanced Technology (NZIAT) is a proposed scientific research agency that would be responsible for boosting economic development through investment in advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is New Zealand Institute for Advanced Technology.
